staffSession.name: __Host-tb_sat
staffSession.description: A staff member's session cookie (separate from the member's, I-51).

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Equal to the CSRF cookie; required on state-changing requests that carry a session.

AreaDto.description: FR-LST-06: the area shown (district) and the location used for distance, rounded to 3 decimals (about 110 m).

publicKey.description: The raw uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes), base64url: 87 characters without padding.

CancellationDto.description: FR-PAY-09: the buyer's request, or the seller's own cancellation, with its reason.

quoteId.description: Courier only: the binding quote from POST /delivery/quotes (Unit 4, I-21).

CheckoutDto.description: FR-FIX-01: fixed-price checkout. The fulfilment method may also be chosen afterwards.

changes.description: Parameter code -> new value, in the stored form, for example {"CP-13": "20 minutes"}.

CreateListingDto.description: A new draft (FR-LST-01). Item kind and sale format are chosen here, and fixed at publication.

DetectionTermDto.description: Staff: a detection term and its flag (FR-CHT-07).

DeviceCheckDto.description: U10-23: the identifier the device shows (an IMEI, a serial number), typed by the buyer at the meetup.

legalReference.description: The request's reference (case, GD or court order number).

notifyUser.description: false only where the law forbids telling the user; then withheldReason says why.

token.description: The 256-bit token from the e-mailed link (base64url).

FeatureDto.description: POST /listings/{id}/feature (FR-MON-05): a CP-37 period and the provider to pay with.

FulfilmentDto.description: FR-DLV-02: the method before payment; courier with its binding quote (Unit 4, I-21).

playerId.description: The in-game player ID; never a login detail.

note.description: Shown to the user with the reason (FR-KYC-06).

KycSubmissionDto.description: FR-KYC-01: the multipart fields; the images are the file parts named by kind.

reason.description: Shown to the seller when returned (10 characters or more).

LoginCheckDto.description: U10-25: what the sign-in page typed in its first step.

MarkReadDto.description: Either some notices by id (up to 100) or all of them.

MfaDisableDto.description: SEC-AUTH-01: turning MFA off takes a current TOTP code, and a new 15-character password if the current one is shorter.

code.description: A 6-digit TOTP code, or a recovery code.

remember.description: U10-25: 'remember this device' for 30 days, after this second factor.

MockAdvanceDto.description: The mock courier's simulator: the next status (omitted: along the happy path) and a return charge in poisha.

MockPayDto.description: The mock provider's page: the outcome the buyer chose (form field).

phone.description: FR-OPS-06: compared with users' numbers for conflicts of interest.

type.description: Physical goods (U7-03); the game-account types answer feature-off until U7-10.

login.description: A mobile number or an e-mail address.

PasswordResetDto.description: SEC-AUTH-10: the link token, or the number and the SMS code; with MFA on, also mfaCode.

PayoutAccountDto.description: FR-PAY-17: a wallet (on the verified number) or a bank account; fields by kind.

showsDefects.description: Multipart text field: "true" when this photo shows the item's defects (FR-LST-02).

PlaceBidDto.description: Section 3.2: a bid is { maximum } in poisha; a plain bid is a maximum equal to the amount.

PostImageDto.description: Multipart: the image in the part "image", and the fields "clientId" and an optional "caption".

PostTextDto.description: FR-CHT-02: the client's message id makes a resend safe.

PreferencesDto.description: FR-NTF-05: the language of notices; transactional e-mails on or off (security notices are always sent).

Problem.description: The answer to every refusal and failure (kernel/http/problems.ts).

liveCheck.description: What the operator saw on the game's live profile.

reason.description: Required for a rejection (10 characters or more); the seller sees it.

ProposalDto.description: A suggested point, or a place of the parties' own with an optional pin (U4-03): exactly one.

PublishListingDto.description:
Publishing (FR-LST-12). An auction's terms are given here and fixed from then on (FR-LST-07): start price,
optional reserve, and one of the CP-07 durations. A fixed-price listing sends an empty body.

text.description: null or empty removes the text.

password.description: Sent again so the rules that involve the number can be checked; it must match the first step's password.

RegisterCompleteDto.description: FR-ACC-01, FR-ACC-04: the last step: the mobile number, the age confirmation and the versions of the terms and the privacy notice accepted.

password.description: SEC-AUTH-01: every printable character is accepted; the service checks the length and the blocklist.

RegisterDto.description: FR-ACC-01: the first step of registration (U10-25): the name, the e-mail address and the password. The password policy is checked by the service.

targetType.description: A chat thread or message is reported in the chat: POST /threads/{id}/reports.

ReportDto.description: FR-CHT-06: the thread, or one message by its sequence number; the category of FR-TNS-01.

description.description: What went wrong, for the dispute (20 characters or more); a default text otherwise.

SavedPaymentMethodDto.description: U10-23: the buyer's default payment method, as a label only: never a card number, a code or a PIN.

enc.description: The sender's encapsulated key: a 65-byte P-256 point, base64url.

SecondChanceDecisionDto.description: FR-AUC-15: the offered bidder accepts (a second_chance order is created) or declines (the next bidder is offered).

login.description: A Bangladeshi mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX or +8801XXXXXXXXX) or an e-mail address.

password.description: DV-8: at most 256 characters, which bounds the Argon2id work.

StartPaymentDto.description: FR-PAY-01: which provider's page to pay on.

code.description: An SMS code, a TOTP code or a recovery code.

TermsAcceptanceDto.description: U10-23: the terms the buyer accepted, and their version.

UpdateListingDto.description: An edit (FR-LST-07): only the fields sent change.
